justification: Changes which council rules are proven (and so shown) by the nightly check; not critical because a rule is proven only if every word is the council's printed text in order, and rules already proven are never re-judged.

pre_impl.existing_data: regulatory_provisions quote_status/council_quote/quote_page, written by council_quote.py --apply (nightly, after dcp-commit)
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: A lone line that looks like a label but is a value: only punctuated labels (a. (b) iv) 2.) are skipped, never a bare number
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Existing unconfirmed rows: the nightly --unchecked run and any per-chapter run re-judge them
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: If wrong, a rule shows the council's printed text including the label line; text is always copied from the PDF

functions.name: judge_twice
functions.output: verdict dict with status, reason, quote and quote_page for the rule
functions.if_none: no stream text gives the same unconfirmed verdict as before

break_it.scenario: A bare table value '3' skipped lets 'Maximum storeys 2' be proven over a printed 3
break_it.what_happens: a rule shown as proven with the wrong storey number

break_it.scenario: Skipped-label search changes the anchor of a rule already proven
break_it.what_happens: a proven quote changes or fails
break_it.how: judge_twice runs the second pass only on unconfirmed verdicts; dry-run 35 chapters, 22,532 rules: 0 changed

break_it.scenario: Reader's words differ from the council's but match once a label line is skipped
break_it.what_happens: a reworded rule shown as proven
break_it.how: the second pass uses the same judge(): exact needs every character in order, recovered needs anchors plus 0.6 overlap and no cut words; the shown text is copied from the PDF

post_merge.manual_verify: Run council_quote.py --apply on the 4 chapters with gains (needs user yes) and re-count hidden rules

falsifiable_check.fails_when: judge_twice skips the second pass (Hornsby 248365 test goes red) or bare numbers count as labels (table test goes red); both mutations were run and went red
falsifiable_check.observed_red: 2026-10-27: second pass replaced by judge(row, streams) -> '1 failed, 44 passed'; label regex made [.)]? -> '1 failed, 44 passed'
